Name: Hardware Store
Author: StuykGaming
Description:
[size=4][b]Hardware Store
[/b][/size]
Add a new local hardware store with a snack vending machine out front at the Bus Stop.

The hardware store sells sprinklers, fertilizer, batteries, vanilla stone and wood pavers at a 1.6% price increase.

The snack vending machine sells Joja Cola, Coffee, Field Snack, Miner Treat, and Bug Steak at a 1.5% price increase.

[b]Requirements[/b]

[list]
[*]ContentPatcher
[*]ExpandedPreconditionsUtility
[*]ShopTileFramework
[/list]
[b]Installation
[/b]Insert this mod in the Mods folder after installing the requirements.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[size=2]This mod [b]should be compatible with 80% of changes to the bus stop area[/b].

[i]Here's a few that are working:[/i]
[list]
[*][size=2]Asters Phonebox Shop[/size]
[*][size=2]SVE[/size]
[*][size=2]Ridgeside Village[/size]
[*][size=2]Stardew Valley Reimagined 3[/size]
[/list]
[/size]
[b]Accessing the Store(s)[/b]
If you are having trouble accessing the two different stores on a controller, you can try moving your right joystick over the door and hitting `A` to open the store. It's sometimes kind of janky, but it works.

Downloads.Description: Main hardware store files. Potentially fixes overlay issue with layers. Patch provided by gamingtester
